notes: D058 (M.G.L. c. 186, § 31) covers a procedural requirement for notices to quit for nonpayment of rent. The landlord must attach a state-developed form that lists rental assistance resources and court rules and includes a statement that the notice is not an eviction. Courts may not accept a nonpayment eviction filing without proof the form was delivered. This is notice-to-quit procedure, which is explicitly out of scope. The section does not limit the reasons a landlord may end a tenancy, so it is not a just_cause_eviction rule. It also does not touch rent caps, security deposits, fees, screening or algorithmic pricing. No records were extracted.
